answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The final reply orders the work as 'Fix these before launch' (items 1-5), 'Fix next' (6-11) and 'Smaller issues', with a 'Suggested order' explaining that items 1, 2 and 5 come first because they create wrong or duplicate reservations or lock members out. It also names what it did not check ('I did not run the pages in a browser or on a phone, and I did not test them with a screen reader') and says a real-phone run in dark mode with VoiceOver at 200% text size 'is still to do'.

mapping.title: Closed days can be picked; refused only at Confirm with no way back
mapping.reason: Same as D06: any calendar day can be chosen, closed days included, and the refusal ('The library is closed on … Choose another day') only comes on the confirm page, with no link or way to change the day.

mapping.title: Days before the tool's 'Available from' date are not blocked
mapping.reason: D14: days before 'Available from' are not blocked and the reservation succeeds (pressure washer available 17 Oct reserved for Sat 10 Oct), so the desk holds a reservation for a tool it does not have.

mapping.title: Pick-up date chosen twice and the two can disagree
mapping.reason: D15: the tool-page day and the basket session are not reconciled, and the confirm page shows 'pick up Saturday 17 October' above 'Pick-up session: Wednesday 21 October'. It also mentions the double entry (D23), but its main harm is the two dates contradicting each other, with the closed-day check reading the wrong one, which is D15.

mapping.title: Basket hold expires silently, then a misleading error and lock-out
mapping.reason: D10: the basket only says 'Items are held for you while you finish' and never shows the ten-minute limit, and on expiry Continue says 'Something went wrong. Try again.' The claim that retrying never works is part of how the lapsed hold is handled, and the proposed fix (state the limit, warn, say plainly that it expired) fixes D10.

mapping.title: Truncated tool names make the two drills look identical on a phone
mapping.reason: D03: names are cut to one line with an ellipsis, so both cordless drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, co…' at 375 px.

mapping.title: On phones results come before search; date filter behind icon-only button
mapping.reason: D01: at 480 px and below the results come before the search form, and the 'Available from' filter sits behind an icon-only button below the list.

mapping.title: Desktop: form shown first but coded after the results
mapping.reason: This is wrong according to the packet. D01 says the document order is form then results, so on desktop, where the form is shown first, code order and visual order agree. The real order mismatch is at phone widths, which is D01 and already counted under R6.

mapping.title: 330 px minimum column causes sideways scrolling
mapping.reason: D05: the results grid's 330 px minimum column makes the page scroll sideways at 320 px and at high zoom.

mapping.title: Search with no results leaves the old list and no message
mapping.reason: D02: a search with no match leaves the previous list on screen, with no 'no tools match' message and nothing announced.

mapping.title: Double-tapping Confirm makes two reservations
mapping.reason: D12: Confirm stays enabled with no visible busy state during the 1.5 s wait, so a second tap makes a second reservation number and the desk sets the tool aside twice.

mapping.title: Basket Continue button has no busy state
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth: D12 covers the Confirm button and D10 the hold message. The basket's Continue also waits (1.2 s per D10) with nothing on screen showing it is working, so a member on a slow phone cannot tell the tap registered and may tap again or give up.

mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge fails contrast
mapping.reason: D04: in the dark theme the badge text #2f7d4a on #1d2622 is about 3.07:1 for 16 px bold text, below the 4.5:1 it needs.

mapping.title: Dark-mode badge background matches the card
mapping.reason: The harm to legibility is the text contrast, already mapped to D04 under R12. That the badge 'doesn't look like a badge' is a styling remark, and no effect on members is stated or evident.

mapping.title: Loan-length list traps Tab; Escape and tapping outside don't close it
mapping.reason: D09: inside the open loan-length list, Tab and Shift+Tab only cycle through the options and Escape does not close it. Tapping outside is the same can't-leave-the-list problem, and the fix (radios or a native select) removes both.

mapping.title: Loan-length button's accessible name is only 'One week'
mapping.reason: D16: the button's accessible name is just its current value, 'One week', without 'Loan length'.

mapping.title: 'Added to your basket' vanishes after about 1.2 s with no next step
mapping.reason: D07: the feedback after the press lasts about 1.2 s, and the only lasting way forward is the small 'Basket (1)' header link. The item does not claim the member believes the tool is already reserved, so it is D07, not D26.

mapping.title: Basket sessions shown in reverse order
mapping.reason: D11: row-reverse and wrap-reverse put the latest session first on screen, while keyboard and screen-reader users get them earliest first.

mapping.title: Membership and phone checks too strict
mapping.reason: D17: 'ft-01234', 'FT 01234', '+44 7700 900123' and '07700 900 123' are all rejected, and nothing normalises them first.

mapping.title: 'Open' becomes an unlabelled dot on phones
mapping.reason: D20: below 480 px the word 'Open' on session days becomes an unlabelled 8 px dot, so on a phone it is hard to see which days are sessions.

mapping.title: Done page makes up a reservation number without data
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth: if the done page is opened without reservation data (for example reopened later from history), it shows 'FT-4471' as though a reservation exists. A member can then believe in, or quote at the desk, a reservation number that is not theirs.

mapping.title: Reservation numbers look like membership numbers
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth: membership numbers (FT-01234) and reservation numbers (FT-4471) share the 'FT-' prefix and look alike. Members can give the wrong one at the desk or type the reservation number into the membership field.

mapping.title: Basket not emptied after confirming
mapping.reason: D18: after confirmation the basket still holds the tools unless 'Reserve another tool' is tapped, so the same tool can be reserved again.

mapping.title: 'Up to three tools' limit not enforced
mapping.reason: D21: the stated limit of three tools is not enforced.

mapping.title: Fixed Reserve bar covers the footer and desk phone number
mapping.reason: D08, stated more narrowly: nothing keeps the tool page clear of the fixed Reserve bar, so the footer with the desk phone number sits under it at the end of the page, a case D08 names.

mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' is not announced
mapping.reason: D19: when Reserve is tapped with no day chosen, the error is not read out and focus moves to the first day button.

mapping.title: Card tool names are h2 inside the 'Tools' h2
mapping.reason: This is only about heading nesting. With the card names at h2, screen-reader users can still find the tools and jump between them by heading, so no member is held up. It is a markup tidy-up, not a barrier.

mapping.title: Done page reads the tool name twice
mapping.reason: D24: the visually hidden #c-tool on the done page makes screen readers read the reserved tool's name twice.
